A state BJP leader shared a clip of the incident alleging that **Banerjee** attempted to pressure the hospital to admit her nephew despite his reports showing no significant injuries. The BJP has denied any involvement in the attack, while **Banerjee** claimed that the BJP was pressuring the hospital against admitting her nephew.

recent_articles.title: Cross-border job scam: 453 Nepali victims repatriated from UP’s Kushinagar after police crackdown | Lucknow News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A **Nepal**ian government-led operation rescued 453 migrants from an alleged cross-border job scam in Uttar Pradesh's Kushinagar district. The victims, mostly poor Nepali nationals who spoke only Nepali, were lured to India with promises of skill training and lucrative employment opportunities but were instead cheated out of money and subjected to harassment.  The **Nepal**ian embassy coordinated the operation, which involved police tracing the migrants' rented accommodation and rescuing them from the alleged recruitment network. The suspects are facing criminal charges for cheating and other offenses.

recent_articles.title: Kasol firing: Tourist shoots local youth after parking dispute, four arrested - Himachal Pradesh News | India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A parking dispute in Kasol market escalated into violence when a tourist allegedly shot a local youth, leaving him injured. The incident triggered panic and led to the arrest of four suspects by **police** who seized the pistol and vehicle used in the shooting.  The viral videos of the incident have drawn widespread attention and outrage, raising concerns about tourist behavior in Himachal Pradesh's popular tourist destination.
